openFindings.title: A runtime-project symlink bypasses the scratch boundary
Codex runs without a host filesystem sandbox
SIGINT during setup leaves the detached setup child running
Setup-time repository writes occur before the baseline snapshot
Unreadable snapshot subtrees are treated as empty
Cleanup reports child processes gone without verification
Removed pre-existing project hook trust is not restored
AC-005 is marked Met without evidence for its specs write case
